title: Dino Learns to Clean
moral: Cleaning up keeps things safe and organized.

scenes.summary: Dino the elephant loves playing but dislikes cleaning up.
scenes.text:
Dino the Elephant Who Didn’t Clean Up

In a bright jungle clearing, lived a cheerful little elephant named Dino.

Dino loved to play all day.

He played with leaves, sticks, and colorful flowers.

But there was one thing Dino did not like…

Cleaning up.
scenes.image_prompt: cute elephant playing with leaves and sticks in jungle clearing, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Dino keeps leaving a mess and ignores advice from his friend.
scenes.text:
After playing, Dino left everything scattered.

Leaves here…

Sticks there…

Flowers everywhere!

“Dino, you should clean up,” said Lulu the Lion Cub.

But Dino laughed.

“I’ll do it later!” he said.

Day after day, the mess grew bigger.

Soon, Dino’s play area was full of clutter.

He couldn’t find his favorite toys.

“Where is my stick?” he wondered.

But it was lost in the mess.
scenes.image_prompt: messy jungle clearing with elephant and lion cub, toys scattered everywhere, cartoon style

scenes.summary: The messy area causes problems when it rains.
scenes.text:
One day, it started to rain.

Water filled the clearing.

The scattered leaves blocked the path.

The sticks floated around.

Dino slipped!

“Oops!” he cried.
scenes.image_prompt: elephant slipping in rainy messy clearing with floating sticks and leaves, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Miko helps Dino clean up and organize the area.
scenes.text:
Just then, Miko the Monkey came by.

“Let’s clean this up!” Miko said.

Together, they picked up the sticks…

Gathered the leaves…

And cleared the path.
scenes.image_prompt: monkey and elephant cleaning jungle clearing together, teamwork cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Dino learns to clean up and enjoys a neat space.
scenes.text:
Soon, the clearing was clean again.

Everything looked neat and bright.

Dino smiled.

“This feels so nice!” he said.

From that day on, Dino cleaned up after playing.

And he never lost his toys again.

Cleaning up keeps things safe and easy to find.

A little effort makes a big difference.

The End
